messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected in gateway (us-west-2). 5xx spike + TLS handshake failures since 09:02 UTC. SLO impact: increased latency and ~12% request failures to /v1/generate. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: I'm on it. APM shows 5xxs concentrated on edge-proxy cluster -> upstream handshakes failing. Link: https://datadog.example/incidents/1853123456
alex.s: seeing a ton of TLS alerts in proxy logs: 'tls: handshake failure: tls: unsupported certificate' - grabbing recent cert chain from vault.
samira: I can validate cert expiry. Running: `openssl x509 -noout -dates -in /tmp/chain.pem` from the node, but pushing to one of the edge instances now.
oncall-sre: Copying logs -> `tail -n 200 /var/log/proxy/error.log | grep -i handshake | tail -n 50` shows: `handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate` and `remote error: tls: certificate unknown` repeated.
alex.s: quick check: `openssl s_client -connect gateway-usw2:443 -showcerts` shows server chain missing an intermediate CA (chain truncated). Upstream mTLS requires full chain.
devon: Did we rotate any certs or CA yesterday? I see a CRON that pulls new chains at 02:00 UTC for the client certs. Checking gitops: https://git.example/repo/infra/edge/certs
emily.pd: Customer-facing: we have around 9 customers showing elevated error rates (support tracking). Raising to SEV2 for now, notifying CS.
samira: Confirmed: intermediate cert expired (not the leaf) — expiry date 2026-03-13 23:59 UTC on some nodes, others still serving old chain. Looks like a partial roll caused a mixed chain state -> mTLS peers rejecting.
oncall-sre: That matches the spike timeframe. If some proxies have truncated chain, downstream mTLS validations fail. Immediate mitigation options: 1) roll back to previous full-chain on affected nodes, 2) temporarily relax client-cert verification (risky), 3) re-deploy updated full chain to all edge nodes urgently. Thoughts?
alex.s: Don't relax verification unless we have to. Fastest path: push full chain to all routers and trigger hot-reload. I can prepare the bundle.
devon: I have a script to push certs: `./scripts/push-chain --env prod --region usw2 --bundle full-chain.pem` and triggers envoy reload via SIGHUP. Want me to run?
oncall-sre: Yes please. Run on canaries first. Monitor error rate.
ops-bot: deploy:starting devon pushed full-chain to 2 canaries (edge-01, edge-02) — reload triggered.
devon: Canaries look good, handshake errors dropped on those nodes to near zero in 30s. Rolling to remaining 8 nodes now.
alex.s: After roll completed on all nodes, aggregated 5xx went from 12% -> 1.1% within 3 minutes. Still monitoring for residual clients that cached broken chain.
emily.pd: Noting customer impact: ~15 min window of degraded service for some customers. CS alerted customers with retries guidance.
oncall-sre: Post-mortem notes so far: root cause = partial cert bundle rollout where intermediate CA was unintentionally omitted from some hosts due to a packaging bug in the rotation job. Action items: fix rotation job to validate full chain before applying; add binary check `openssl verify -CAfile fullchain.pem leaf.pem` pre-deploy; add Canary rollout policy to block partial application; alert rule for chain mismatch.
samira: I'll open the PR to add the `openssl verify` pre-check to the rotation job and add unit test for packaging.
alex.s: Also recommend adding a synthetic check hitting gateway mTLS endpoints from internal agent after rotation to detect handshake regressions before traffic shift.
oncall-sre: Handing off to next on-call in 30m. If anything regresses, page the oncall team again.
emily.pd: Customer comms: initial timeline and mitigation sent. Will follow up with RCA draft.
incident-bot: Incident Status: mitigated -> degraded-> recovered. Duration: ~00:22:00. Assigned ticket: INC-1853123456.
ops-bot: action:created INC-1853123456 - tags: [tls, cert-chain, mtls, gateway, production]
devon: final note — rotation job used `tar --strip-components` which removed the intermediate when extracting on some hosts due to path differences. PR will change extraction and add explicit path checks.
samira: started PR #6148 to add checks, assigning alex.s for review.
oncall-sre: Thanks team. Closing slack thread after RCA posted. :white_check_mark:
